title: App object reference
description: A portable identifier for App-owned data, not authority, a payload, or proof of existence or readability. Component, UTF-8, and canonical URI semantics are specified in object-references.md and enforced by the public objects helpers.

app_id.description: App identifier; lowercase ASCII component, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

object_type.description: Object type declared by the App; lowercase ASCII component, at most 64 UTF-8 bytes.

object_id.description: Opaque, nonempty UTF-8 identifier, at most 1024 bytes, without Unicode control characters. Never trimmed or normalized.

revision.description: Optional opaque, nonempty UTF-8 revision, at most 128 bytes, without Unicode control characters. Absence differs from an empty string.
